Cinematic 10-second dramatic close-up, over-the-shoulder shot. A beautiful young woman in a flowing red hanfu, with long black hair and an ornate golden hair crown and long dangling gold earrings, stands on a muddy battlefield after a battle. Misty mountains and a dark pine forest are behind her under an overcast grey sky. In the right foreground, a tall warrior in dark armor and a black fur collar stands with his back to the camera, softly out of focus.

0–2s: She looks up at him with teary, trembling eyes. Her lips quiver, and a gentle wind blows loose strands of hair across her face.
2–4s: She takes a shaky breath, swallows, and steps slightly closer to him, her eyes glistening.
4–8s: With a voice full of emotion, holding back tears, she speaks softly to him with accurate lip-sync: "You promised me you would come back... Why did you choose this war over me?"
8–10s: A single tear rolls down her cheek. She keeps looking into his eyes, waiting for an answer, as the wind moves her hair and red sleeves.

Very slow push-in on her face, shallow depth of field, soft diffused natural light, muted cold color grading with her red dress as the focal color, emotional Chinese historical drama style, realistic micro-expressions, 4K, film grain, 24fps.

nodes.title: Note: RDNA4 settings and h3accel
widgets_values:
## RDNA4 settings (h3-accel)

Measured on the R9700, 10 s clip: **618 s → ~310–325 s** back-to-back, same character (face check vs the reference image).

### Changes from 01-Minimax_H3_Latent-Upscale-I2V_R2V
- **Load Image 1**: resize to max 1 MP (reference tokens ride through every step)
- **Model Sparse Attention**: sol-attn tau 1.5 (was 1.0); 2.0 changes the picture
- **Stage-1 preview** decode/save muted
- **Latent upscaler** 2D fp16 (3D runs out of VRAM)
- **Final resolution** 1.0 MP (was 1.5)
- **UNET**: Singularity v2 pruned int8

### h3accel nodes (custom_nodes/h3accel)
- **Text Encoder BF16** (after Load CLIP): runs the text encoder's language model in bf16 instead of fp32. Encode 42 s → 12 s. Same weights file.
- **Load VAE (BF16)** (above Stage 2, feeds only the final VAE Decode): decode 43 s → 34 s, 47 dB vs the original.
  - `fast_rms_rope`: Triton RMSNorm+RoPE kernel (-3.2 s)
  - `fast_convrot_quant`: Triton ConvRot int8 quantizer (-1.9 s)
  - The reference-image encode keeps the normal Load VAE, so the clip's composition is unchanged.

All of them work with any H3 diffusion model / LoRA. If something looks wrong after a ComfyUI or comfy-kitchen update, switch the toggles off (or set enabled = false): everything falls back to the stock kernels.

### Steps
BasicScheduler steps = total; SplitSigmas step = stage-1 steps (at least 6, 8+ for better audio); the rest go to the stage-2 upscale (at least 4). This workflow: 12 total, 10 + 2.

### Reference inputs (MiniMax H3 Reference to Video)
- Images: ≤ 9
- Video: ≤ 3 clips, 2–15 s each, ≤ 15 s total
- Audio: ≤ 3 clips, 2–15 s each, ≤ 15 s total; only together with image or video inputs
- At most 12 files in total

### Low VRAM
UniBlockSwap Low VRAM (bypassed, in Load Models) lets this run on ~8 GB of VRAM, much slower. Not needed on 32 GB.

nodes.title: MiniMax H3 Image to Video (first + last frame)
Stage 2: First Frame guide (skipped when the image is bypassed)
Stage 2: Last Frame guide (skipped when the image is bypassed)
Note: First + Last Frame (FL2V)
widgets_values:
## First frame + last frame -> video (FL2V), 2-stage latent upscale

**Use**
- **First Frame** (Load Image 1) and **Last Frame** (Load Image 2). The output size comes from the first frame (Longest Side). The last frame is cover-cropped to that size, so use the same aspect ratio.
- Prompt: describe what happens between the two frames (motion, camera). The H3 prompt writer workflows in `04-prompt` work too.
- Only a first frame: **bypass Last Frame (Load Image 2)**. Image to Video then gets no last frame and the stage-2 Last Frame guide (Add Guide, optional image - ComfyUI-Penguinhelmet) passes through.

**What changed from the R2V workflow**
- Model: `minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot` (official first/last-frame model) + `minimax_h3_fl2v_turbo_8step_v1.0` LoRA at 1.0.
- Steps: scheduler 10, split at 8 -> 8 stage-1 steps + 2 stage-2 steps.
- Stage 1: **MiniMax H3 Image to Video** with `first_frame` + `last_frame` (they are locked at frame 0 and the last frame, and shown to the text encoder).
- Stage 2: the frames are encoded at the stage-1 size, so **Clear Keyframe Guides** (ComfyUI-Penguinhelmet) removes them and two **Add Guide, optional image** nodes (ComfyUI-Penguinhelmet) (frame_idx 0 and -1) put them back at the upscaled size. Stage 2 has its own guider.
- Reference images 3-6 and the reference video are removed: Image to Video has no reference inputs. For character references plus first/last frame, use the R2V workflow and add Add Guide nodes.

**Model files**
- `diffusion_models/minimax-h3/minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`
- `loras/minimax-h3/minimax_h3_fl2v_turbo_8step_v1.0_comfyui_bf16.safetensors`
- the rest as in "Note: Model Links" (text encoder, video / audio VAE, 2D latent upscaler).

**Measured on the R9700** (5 s, 480x864 stage 1 -> 768x1376 output): 182 s cold, 124 s warm (8 x 6.8 s + 2 x 17.6 s), 27 GB VRAM, 46 GB RAM. First and last frames match the inputs.


**Custom nodes**: ComfyUI-Penguinhelmet (Clear Keyframe Guides, Add Guide optional image: https://github.com/penguinhelmet/ComfyUI-Penguinhelmet), ComfyUI-RDNA4-Accel (Text Encoder BF16, Load VAE (BF16): https://github.com/penguinhelmet/ComfyUI-RDNA4-Accel), ComfyUI-Pixaroma and KJNodes (Set/Get, inputs, save).
